## External pull requests are not accepted

Embedito95 does not merge code from outside contributors. This repository is
dual-licensed, and accepting external code requires a signed CLA that does not
exist yet.

Please close this pull request and open an
[issue](https://github.com/davidsal/Embedito95/issues) instead. Bug reports,
minimal reproductions and board reports are welcome there.

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/davidsal/Embedito95/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
